Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: We're giving away free tickets to see everyone's favorite girl rockers - The Bettys.

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Ahhh!

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: All you have to do is be the 444 and 4/4 caller...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! I love fractions.

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: ...and you and your best Betty buddy will get to ride with the band on The Betty bus to see the show.

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Ahhhhh!

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: Call now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after dialing the phone) Oh, it's busy! I've just gotta win! Clearly I'm their biggest fan. See? (Shows her Betty merchandise) Even my Betty boombox which rests on my Betty bedside table next to my Betty bed runs on Betty batteries! (Plays the boombox)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Grab her hair) Obsession rocks! (Release her hair)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know! (The phone rings) Ooh, it's ringing!

Name: Phone announcer
Dialog: Congratulations, you're the winning caller!

Name: Candace and  Stacy
Dialog: AHHHHHH!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Imagine, a whole day of hanging with Crash and the band! And, as an added bonus, (She turns a picture of Phineas and Ferb around.) a whole day of not thinking about my goofy brothers. (Gasps) Just me, you and The Bettys! (horn honks) Ahh, they're here!!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bye! Enjoy your music concert!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Be careful!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have fun on your journey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe we're about to board The Betty Bus!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I bet the bus driver's gonna be a spaced-out rocker!

Name: Dennis
Dialog: H-Hello, girls. My name is Dennis, and I'm with the radio station. (A pig snorts; he reveals one under the seat.) That is Sir Bacon, the band's mascot. According to our focus groups, girls your age overwhelmingly find that cool.

Name: Stacy and Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Totally!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, this place is a total pigsty.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: We love it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Stacy, it's them!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Shh, they're creating!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're your biggest fans!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and we won the contest...and now we get to hang out with you all day!!

Name: Crash
Dialog: (British accent) Well, just keep it down. We're trying to write a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure thing!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no problem.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's The Betty Bass Guitar!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, I know, I know, I know!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Check this out. (To Candace and Stacy) So tell me, girls, would you like to be part of the music-making process and help us write a song?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh!!!

Name: Stacy and Candace
Dialog: Would we?!!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Great. First, we can't possibly write a song in this filth, so you girls can start by cleanin' up the bus. (Hands them a bucket, mop, and broom) Here you go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) All right, Ferb. (Cut to he and Ferb in the backyard with blueprints set out.) What should we do today? One - an escalator to the moon? Two - become secret agents? Three - clone giant hamsters? (Pauses) Hey, where's Perry? (Leans against the tree) Huh. I wonder where he goes when we can't find him.

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: What the...? Some sort of secret room? (They enter.) Wow.

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: What in the world? A secret underground headquarters, with a particle disruptor and...oh, a hovercraft! Looks like we're gonna be secret agents, huh? When did you find the time to build all this, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I -–

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Hang on, hang on. It's here somewhere on this clipboard from which I have yet to look up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent P? P for Phineas, nice touch, Ferb!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually --

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, yes, here it is. Dr. Doofenshmirtz. Huh, what a surprise. Building some sort of destructo ray. End of the world. Yadda, yadda, yadda. I'm faxing you the coordinates.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly-moogly! (He slides down off-screen) Do... (cut to the camera room where Carl is shown piloting the camera.) Carl. Carl, who are those kids?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, boy. They're Agent P's owners, sir. Looks like they found one of our secret tunnels.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sweet! We got our mission, Agent F. To the hover jet!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is that the hover jet? Oh, no, they didn't! (To Perry) There you are, Agent P. Those boys are in jeopardy and not covered under our hover jet insurance plan, so, stop Doofenshmirtz and protect those boys. (Perry flies out on his chair; To Carl) Oh, and where are you going, Mr. The Boys Will Never Find A Tree Tunnel?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow... (looks at buttons on the panel) Laser beam, magnet ray, cup holder?! You really thought of everything, Ferb!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually –-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold that thought. (Looks down and notices

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're all done cleaning the bus.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Oh... (chuckles) we can't get to our song till we deal with our fan mail. Think you could help?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh...!!

Name: Missy
Dialog: (brings over a huge bag of fan mail) Great. You can start with this bag. (Tosses it into Candace's arms)

Name: Tink
Dialog: (British accent) And here's the shredder.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check this one out. (Hands Candace a letter)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. "Beloved Bettys, your band is the biggest, baddest, most bangin' buncha -" Hey, this is my letter. They didn't even read it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, but don't forget - we are on the bus helping the band write a song!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I guess you're right. And you know what the best part is? I haven't even thought about my brothers the whole day.

Name: Candace (cont'd.)
Dialog: Stacy, look, it's my brothers!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Huh? I don't see anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: B-B-But I-I-I could've sworn I –

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think the cleaning supplies are starting to get to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That must be it. (The boys appear again.) That's gotta be it. I'm not even gonna look.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voice-over) Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys. Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen, hums; enters carrying a tray of food) Ah, nothing like a nice snack before testing the Destructinator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah! (muffled) Hey, Perry the Platypus, why do you always go for the nose?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All 250,000 letters opened and shredded.

Name: Tink
Dialog: Oh, I just thought of something. The outside of this bus is dirty, too!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Stacy, I'm beginning to think that The Bettys have just been taking advantage of us this whole time!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you talking about? They've been nothing but... Look out! (They cling to the bus as a mattress truck drives past.) ...nice to us since we got on the bus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughing) My automatic tennis ball server can go all night, Perry the Plat-

Name: Male computer voice
Dialog: Destructinator countdown initiated. Thirty seconds to activation. (Phineas and Ferb land outside.) Thirty, twenty-nine, twenty-eight, twenty-seven, twenty-six, twenty-five, twenty-four, twenty-three, twenty-two...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (overlapping) Wow, Ferb, this evil villain lair is awesome! I see you carved it out with dynamite. Nice, nice. Aw, cool, you got an automatic tennis ball server! Sweet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what's going on, Perry the Platyp–- (Perry sticks a mop in his mouth; muffled speech)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, we're finished washing the outside of the bus. It nearly killed us, but we're finished!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Great work, girls. You've earned a special "surprise."

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really?

Name: Missy
Dialog: You get to scrub the toilets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yay, toilets!

Name: Tink
Dialog: And be sure to get underneath the lid!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, that is it! We're through being your tour monkeys. Right, Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (scrubbing a toilet) Yay, a Betty Bowl Brush!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You've just been using us this whole trip. I mean, is this how you treat your fans? It should be your fans that inspire you to make music. I mean, if you can't see that by now, then you can just drop me off at the next Betty Bus Stop. (Walks away)

Name: Crash
Dialog: Unfortunately, guys...she's right.

Name: Tink
Dialog: I feel like a bit of a Betty butt-head.

Name: Crash
Dialog: We're sorry for treating you so bad. How can we ever make it up to you?

Name: Missy
Dialog: I'll let you bang my Betty Bongos.

Name: Tink
Dialog: Or play my Betty Bass Guitar!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Hey, guys, that's it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...you'll go Betty, Betty far?

Name: Crash
Dialog: Perfect! That rocks!

Name: Dennis
Dialog: Hey, girls, what's goin' on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We just helped the Bettys write - Wait a second. Dennis, if you're here, then who's driving the bus?

Name: Dennis
Dialog: Oh, come on, I'll show you. (Takes them to the driver's seat) Autopilot.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Wow, cool!

Name: Male computer voice
Dialog: Seven, six, five, four, three, two, one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (overlapping) By the way, I love that giant ray gun counting down to zero. OK, seriously, when did you make all this?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Look, for the last time, I didn't –-

Name: Candace
Dialog: He fainted!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams) (Presses the brake pedal) Unh, unh. There's something wrong with the Betty Brakes, and I can't stop the autopilot!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Grab the Betty Emergency Brake!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grabs it, it breaks off; gasps) The Betty Brake broke!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How did you make a working Destructo ray?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, that's the bus Candace is on! I get it, We have to save Candace! What a cool mission!

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: (scream)

Name: Crash
Dialog: Say, what's all the fussin' about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. (Cut to inside where he's tied up and mops are shot into his mouth by the automatic tennis ball launcher.) Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. Curse you, Perry the - Bleah. Why did I buy so many mops? Oof.

Name: All
Dialog: (scream)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming, Candace!

Name: Girls
Dialog: (scream)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent F, activate the magnet ray!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: It's too heavy!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Whatever you're doing, it's working!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you designed this thing... (imitates Captain Kirk) Can you give me...any more power? (The bus attaches to the hovercraft.) Excellent!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: We did it, our sister's safe!

Name: The Bettys, Stacy
Dialog: (cheer) Brilliant!/You did it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent F, let's head home. (They leave.)

Name: Crash
Dialog: Way to go, Candace! Now we are your biggest fans! How can we thank you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you can come to my house and clean up my room.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm serious.

Name: Crash
Dialog: How about you sing with us onstage instead?

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: (both gasp) It's a deal! (both squeal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can't wait to get home and tell Mom all about our secret spy adventure. (They get zapped by a ray.) Hey, what's goin' on? (Perry is using his tractor beam behind them.) It's like we're stuck in some sort of tractor beam.

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. Seriously, Phineas, what are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (imitates James Bond) That, my friend, is classified information.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, what a great day. Not one phone call from Candace with some crazy, unbelievable story about–

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Guess what Ferb did! He made a secret tunnel and a spy headquarters and a villain's lair and a hover jet shaped like Perry...tell her, Ferb!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I -– !

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait a second. Why are you two soaking wet?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ach! I give up! (stomps off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We fell in Isabella's pool.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that I believe. (To Perry, who enters) Oh, hi, Perry. (To herself) I wonder how Candace is doing.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Oi! We'd like to bring a very special person to the stage. She's not only Bettys' best fan, but she also saved all of our lives! Ladies and gentlemen, Candace, and her best friend Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do you think your brothers are doing right now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who cares?
